Program

The Essentials Program

Twelve weeks, three days a week: full body, upper, lower. Heavy compounds first, dropsets and supersets to finish. Every exercise lists two substitutions.

  • Abdominals
  • Biceps
  • Calves
  • Chest
  • Forearms
  • Glutes
  • Hamstrings
  • Lats
  • Lower Back
  • Middle Back
  • Quadriceps
  • Shoulders
  • Traps
  • Triceps

The schedule

Train three days a week with 1-2 rest days between sessions: Full Body, Upper, Lower. The same three workouts repeat for four weeks, then the exercises change: three blocks across twelve weeks.

How progression works

Every exercise prescribes a rep range and an RPE target. Add reps or weight week to week while keeping form consistent; the app’s progression suggestions follow the rep ranges.
